evidence_summary: AREDS2 enrolled people with intermediate AMD in both eyes or intermediate AMD in one eye and advanced AMD in the other.
People without AMD or with early AMD were excluded because AREDS showed no benefit for them.
Lutein/zeaxanthin belongs to an AREDS2 formula context, not a universal 'eye-health' supplement.
personalization: Determine whether formulation-specific evidence differs from parent ingredient; no unvalidated dose conversion or automatic clinical claim.
